name: Restaurant & Juice House
description: Full-service restaurant seamlessly integrated with a fresh juice, smoothie, and wellness bar. Tailored for health-conscious, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, and active-lifestyle dining concepts pairing scratch-made culinary entrées with raw cold-pressed juices.

sections.name: Fresh Juices
sections.description: Features 100% pure cold-pressed, centrifugal, and hand-extracted juices crafted to order from whole fruits and crisp vegetables with zero added sugars, water, or preservatives. Serves as the core beverage identity for guests seeking immediate raw vitamins and natural hydration.

subSections.name: Single Fruit Juices
subSections.description: Pure unblended freshly pressed juices highlighting individual fruit flavors including sweet orange, crisp green apple, ruby red grapefruit, and cold-pressed pomegranate.

subSections.name: Mixed & Combination Juices
subSections.description: Carefully balanced signature blends pairing complementary fruits, roots, and citrus such as apple-carrot-beet, orange-mango-passionfruit, and pineapple-ginger.

subSections.name: Vegetable & Green Juices
subSections.description: Nutrient-dense, low-glycemic green juices pressed with dark leafy kale, baby spinach, crisp cucumber, celery stalk, fresh parsley, and tart green apple.

sections.name: Smoothies & Blends
sections.description: Offers rich, thick, fiber-dense blended beverages prepared to order with whole frozen fruits, superfood greens, plant milks, and nutritional enhancers. Provides satisfying meal supplements, post-workout recovery options, and energizing guilt-free refreshments.

subSections.name: Fruit Smoothies
subSections.description: Thick creamy blends of ripe wild berries, bananas, tropical mango, passion fruit, and crushed strawberries blended with chilled liquid bases.

subSections.name: Green & Detox Smoothies
subSections.description: Alkalizing, chlorophyll-rich blends combining baby spinach, fresh kale, hass avocado, crisp cucumber, mint, and coconut water.

subSections.name: Protein & Energy Smoothies
subSections.description: High-protein blends formulated with whey or organic plant protein, natural peanut or almond butter, chia seeds, and raw cacao.

sections.name: Health & Wellness Shots
sections.description: Delivers concentrated 2 oz functional wellness shots designed for rapid nutrient absorption, metabolic stimulation, anti-inflammatory support, and immune defense. Perfect as quick counter elixirs or companion boosts to main meals.

subSections.name: Ginger & Turmeric Shots
subSections.description: Potent root extracts concentrated in gingerol and curcumin, paired with cracked black pepper and fresh lemon for enhanced bio-availability.

subSections.name: Wheatgrass & Green Shots
subSections.description: Freshly cut and pressed living wheatgrass, spirulina elixirs, and chlorophyll greens delivering vital enzymes, bio-available iron, and alkalizing minerals.

subSections.name: Immunity & Vitality Shots
subSections.description: Fast-acting immune formulas combining oil of oregano, raw garlic, apple cider vinegar, cayenne pepper, and elderberry.

sections.name: Fresh Lemonades & Coolers
sections.description: Features handcrafted fruit lemonades, cold-steeped herbal coolers, sparkling spritzers, and botanical mocktails. Provides thirst-quenching, palate-cleansing refreshment to accompany lunch, dinner, and afternoon table dining.

subSections.name: Classic & Fruit Lemonades
subSections.description: Freshly squeezed Meyer lemonades infused with garden mint, wild strawberries, passion fruit, lavender, or pressed pomegranate.

subSections.name: Coolers & Mocktails
subSections.description: Sparkling botanical spritzes, cucumber-basil sodas, citrus hibiscus coolers, and zero-proof handcrafted mocktails.

sections.name: Appetizers & Starters
sections.description: Presents vibrant scratch-cooked first courses, seasonal comforting soups, farm-fresh salads, and shareable mezze plates. Establishes the restaurant's culinary craft with wholesome Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, and plant-forward starters designed to awaken the palate.

subSections.name: Soups
subSections.description: Nourishing, slow-simmered vegetable purées, spiced red lentil soups, restorative bone broths, and chilled seasonal gazpachos served with artisanal bread.

subSections.name: Salads
subSections.description: Vibrant salads featuring crisp baby greens, ancient grains, grilled vegetables, crumbled sheep feta, and cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil vinaigrettes.

subSections.name: Small Plates & Shares
subSections.description: Shareable mezze spreads, roasted seasonal vegetables, warm filled pastries, falafel patties, and artisanal finger-friendly starters.

sections.name: Main Courses / Entrées
sections.description: Anchors the lunch and dinner dining experience with hearty, chef-crafted complete meals. Offers balanced plates composed of lean poultry, tender meats, sustainably caught seafood, and wholesome plant-powered entrées accompanied by nutritious grains and fresh vegetables.

subSections.name: Meat & Poultry
subSections.description: Herb-roasted free-range chicken, slow-braised lamb shanks, spiced tenderloin cuts, and lean poultry dishes paired with nutrient-dense sides.

subSections.name: Seafood
subSections.description: Pan-seared wild salmon, garlic herb jumbo prawns, baked Mediterranean sea bass, and seafood stews simmered with aromatic herbs.

subSections.name: Vegetarian & Vegan Mains
subSections.description: Hearty plant-based entrées including roasted vegetable tagines, spiced chickpea bowls, stuffed eggplants, and grain-based protein platters.

sections.name: Grills & Specialties
sections.description: Showcases open-flame charcoal and wood-grilled meats, flame-seared seafood skewers, and house specialty platters. Celebrates smoky Mediterranean, Levantine, and hearth-cooked flavors with premium marinades, char-grilled tenderness, and chef signatures.

subSections.name: Grilled Meats
subSections.description: Charcoal-grilled ribeye cuts, tender lamb chops, marinated beef skewers, and herb-marinated chicken breast brochettes.

subSections.name: Grilled Seafood
subSections.description: Whole grilled Mediterranean sea bass, flame-charred octopus, grilled salmon skewers, and jumbo prawns basted with oregano lemon oil.

subSections.name: House Specialties
subSections.description: Signature mixed grill sharing platters, clay pot roasted meat specialties, and chef-curated banquet feasts.

sections.name: Sides & Extras
sections.description: Provides essential hot and cold side portions, wholesome grains, freshly baked flatbreads, and scratch-made culinary sauces and dips. Gives diners the flexibility to personalize and enrich their meals with extra nourishment.

subSections.name: Hot Sides
subSections.description: Oven-roasted herbed potatoes, grilled asparagus, steamed seasonal greens, hand-cut fries, and warm artisanal flatbreads.

subSections.name: Cold Sides
subSections.description: Marinated kalamata olives, house vegetable pickles, herb tabouleh, cucumber ribbon salad, and chilled grain salads.

subSections.name: Sauces & Dips
subSections.description: Artisanal small-batch hummus, tzatziki, garlic toum, tahini sauce, spicy red harissa, and chimichurri.

sections.name: Desserts
sections.description: Presents a balanced dessert finale combining warm comforting baked specialties, chilled pastry delights, and refreshing platters of freshly sliced seasonal exotic fruits and berries.

subSections.name: Hot Desserts
subSections.description: Oven-warm chocolate lava cakes, spiced apple and pear crumbles, warm sweet cheese knafeh, and date puddings.

subSections.name: Cold Desserts
subSections.description: Chilled cheesecakes, raw vegan avocado lime tarts, chia seed puddings, and artisanal gelato or fruit sorbets.

subSections.name: Fruit Platters
subSections.description: Freshly carved seasonal melon, pineapple, berries, passion fruit, and figs presented with mint leaves and raw honey-lime dipping sauce.

sections.name: Kids' Menu
sections.description: Designed specifically for younger diners (ages 12 and under), offering balanced, wholesome, and approachable meals, gentle fruit smoothies, fresh juices, and fun desserts made without artificial ingredients.

subSections.name: Kids' Mains
subSections.description: Nutritious and kid-friendly entrées such as grilled chicken tenders, mild mini beef skewers, cheese flatbread melts, and buttered or tomato penne pasta.

subSections.name: Kids' Drinks
subSections.description: Junior 8 oz freshly squeezed juices, gentle berry banana smoothies, and organic milk with no added refined sugars.

subSections.name: Kids' Desserts
subSections.description: Modest-portioned child treats such as fresh fruit skewers with honey yogurt dip, single-scoop fruit sorbets, and mini warm brownie bites.

sections.name: Hot Beverages
sections.description: Features freshly brewed specialty coffee roasts, single-origin espresso drinks, premium whole-leaf teas, and therapeutic herbal infusions. Serves as a satisfying conclusion to meals or a comforting morning and afternoon beverage.

subSections.name: Coffee
subSections.description: Espresso, americano, cappuccino, flat white, caffe latte, and single-origin batch brew drip coffee prepared from freshly roasted beans.

subSections.name: Tea
subSections.description: Curated whole-leaf green, black, and oolong teas, along with caffeine-free botanical infusions such as chamomile, fresh mint, and ginger lemon.

sections.name: Soft Drinks
sections.description: Provides chilled packaged sparkling and still bottled waters, natural craft sodas, and non-juice carbonated refreshments to ensure comprehensive beverage options for every guest preference.

subSections.name: Soft Drinks
subSections.description: Artisanal ginger beers, natural colas, diet sodas, flavored sparkling tonics, and zero-calorie carbonated waters.

subSections.name: Water
subSections.description: Premium still natural artesian water, sparkling natural mineral water, and infused waters served in chilled glass bottles.

sections.name: Breakfast & Bowls
sections.description: Dedicated morning dining offering farm-fresh breakfast plates, poached eggs, warm shakshuka skillets, avocado toasts, and superfood smoothie and açaí bowls loaded with organic fruit and seeds.

subSections.name: Breakfast Plates
subSections.description: Nourishing morning dishes including poached eggs on artisanal sourdough, spiced tomato shakshuka, breakfast egg wraps, and warm grain porridge.

subSections.name: Smoothie & Açaí Bowls
subSections.description: Thick chilled organic açaí, dragonfruit, and green superfood bases generously topped with gluten-free granola, freshly sliced berries, banana, cacao nibs, and toasted coconut.

timeBehavior.note: Available daily during breakfast and morning hours only (07:00 to 12:00)

sections.name: Detox & Cleanse Packages
sections.description: Multi-bottle cold-pressed juice programs, functional wellness shots, and structured cleanse schedules packaged for takeaway. Formulated to support digestive reset, cellular detoxification, and full-body revitalization.

subSections.name: Guided Cleanse Programs
subSections.description: Numbered daily juice sets formulated for beginner resets, deep green alkalizing detoxification, and active lifestyle recovery.

subSections.name: Immunity & Booster Packs
subSections.description: Multi-bottle sets of cold-pressed ginger elixirs, raw turmeric boosters, and vitality shots for ongoing weekly home wellness routines.

timeBehavior.note: Requires 24-hour advance order notice for freshly pressed batch packaging

sections.name: Seasonal Specials
sections.description: Highlights rotating chef specials, peak-harvest seasonal juices, and limited-run culinary creations that evolve with seasonal harvests and local farm availability. Keeps the menu fresh and dynamic throughout the year.

subSections.name: Seasonal Kitchen Specials
subSections.description: Limited-edition savory entrées, seasonal harvest risottos, and chef-curated market plates showcasing seasonal local produce.

subSections.name: Seasonal Drinks & Juices
subSections.description: Rotational fresh fruit juice combinations, spiced autumn ciders, summer watermelon coolers, and festive holiday wellness drinks.

systemFeatures.name: Nutritional Add-On Boosters
systemFeatures.description: Enables customers to customize juices, smoothies, elixirs, and breakfast bowls with targeted functional supplements, organic protein powders, superfoods, and adaptogens.

systemFeatures.name: Custom Spice Levels
systemFeatures.description: Allows dining patrons to specify chili heat and spice intensity across starters, main courses, grills, and house specialty sauces.

systemFeatures.name: Meat & Grill Doneness Customization
systemFeatures.description: Provides culinary cooking temperature and doneness options for steaks, chops, skewers, and grilled specialties.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Lifestyle Tagging
systemFeatures.description: Flags allergens (gluten, dairy, nuts, eggs, soy, shellfish, sesame) and dietary preferences (vegan, vegetarian, halal, keto, organic) across all food and beverage offerings.

systemFeatures.name: Real-Time Availability & Stock Badges
systemFeatures.description: Communicates live kitchen and juice bar inventory status badges such as In Stock, Sold Out Today, Seasonal, and Made to Order to manage customer expectations.

systemFeatures.name: Cleanse Package Pre-Orders
systemFeatures.description: Facilitates advance booking and scheduled pickup date/time selection for multi-day juice cleanse packages that require advance batch cold-press extraction.

systemFeatures.name: Junior Dining & Kids' Menu Controls
systemFeatures.description: Dedicated configuration and display controls for family dining, offering portion-sized wholesome meals, healthy fruit drinks, and fun junior desserts.
